# A02 — report

Written after the arc ran and before anything was decided. It carries no decision
header of either declared form, so it contributes zero decision rows and its prose is
indexed under its own identity rather than under a holding's.

## What was measured

The repeat variance first, because a single-run comparison has no noise floor and the
gap between two arms is only readable against one.

## What was not measured

Nothing about the second clip's hands at the fastest part of the turn, which is where
structure is hardest and where a still would have decided the question.
